ketamine.outcome_summary: This scoping review mapped literature on ketamine/esketamine use with psychotherapy for depression. While previous reviews suggested benefit for Ketamine/Esketamine Assisted Psychotherapy (KAP/ES-KAP), this review found KAP studies were limited by a lack of RCTs and comparison groups. Higher quality data supported a Ketamine/Esketamine Combined with Psychotherapy (KCP/ES-KCP) model, with some studies suggesting benefit when combined with CBT. Further high-quality research is needed.
